columnPool.label: Route: High Speed 1
columnPool.display: Is part of the High Speed 1 route
columnPool.hint: The high-speed 'Javelin' route from London St Pancras via Ebbsfleet International and Ashford International, fanning out to the Medway towns and the Kent coast (Margate/Ramsgate/Dover/Canterbury).

columnPool.label: Route: North Kent
columnPool.display: Is part of the North Kent route
columnPool.hint: The line along the Thames estuary from London via Dartford, Gravesend and the Medway towns to Faversham - not the coastal Thanet loop.

columnPool.label: Route: Medway Valley
columnPool.display: Is part of the Medway Valley route
columnPool.hint: The branch line following the River Medway between Strood and Paddock Wood via Maidstone West - a different route from the Medway towns' main line.

columnPool.label: Route: East Kent Coast
columnPool.display: Is part of the East Kent Coast route
columnPool.hint: The coastal loop around Thanet and East Kent - Margate, Broadstairs, Ramsgate, Sandwich, Deal - linking back to Faversham.

columnPool.label: Route: Chatham Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chatham Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The original 'via Chatham' route to the coast - Rochester, Chatham, Sittingbourne, Faversham - reaching Dover via Canterbury East. This is different from the Southeastern Main Line, which runs via Ashford instead.

columnPool.label: Route: Maidstone East
columnPool.display: Is part of the Maidstone East route
columnPool.hint: The line linking Maidstone East south-east to Ashford International (via Bearsted, Harrietsham, Lenham, Charing) and north-west toward Otford.

columnPool.label: Route: Southeastern Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Southeastern Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The original South Eastern route to the coast - via Sevenoaks, Tonbridge and the Weald (Marden, Staplehurst, Headcorn) to Ashford, then on to Folkestone and Dover. This is the route via Ashford - not the Chatham route via Faversham/Ramsgate/Margate/Canterbury West.

columnPool.label: Route: East Kent Local
columnPool.display: Is part of the East Kent Local route
columnPool.hint: Local stopping stations between Faversham and Ashford/Folkestone via Canterbury West - the smaller stops most fast trains skip.

columnPool.label: Route: Canterbury East Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Canterbury East Line route
columnPool.hint: The line linking Dover Priory to Canterbury East via Kearsney, Shepherds Well, Snowdown, Aylesham and Adisham.

columnPool.label: Route: Maidstone East Extended
columnPool.display: Is part of the Maidstone East Extended route
columnPool.hint: The Ashford-Maidstone East stretch via Pluckley, Charing, Lenham, Hollingbourne and Bearsted.

columnPool.label: Route: Ashford Canterbury
columnPool.display: Is part of the Ashford Canterbury route
columnPool.hint: The direct line between Ashford International and Canterbury West, via Wye, Chilham, Chartham and Sturry.

columnPool.label: Route: Ashford Canterbury West
columnPool.display: Is part of the Ashford Canterbury West route
columnPool.hint: The direct line between Ashford International and Canterbury West, via Wye, Chilham, Chartham and Sturry - the same corridor as the Ashford Canterbury route.

columnPool.label: Route: Hastings Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Hastings Line route
columnPool.hint: The Ashford-Tonbridge stretch of the Hastings line, via Headcorn, Staplehurst, Marden and Paddock Wood.

columnPool.label: Route: East Kent Connector
columnPool.display: Is part of the East Kent Connector route
columnPool.hint: The link joining Canterbury West to the Folkestone/Ashford corridor via Sandling, and separately to the Isle of Thanet via Bekesbourne and Minster.

columnPool.label: Route: Sheerness Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Sheerness Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short branch from Sittingbourne over the River Swale to Sheerness-on-Sea on the Isle of Sheppey - Kent's only offshore railway.
